name: search_documentation
description: Search official AWS documentation and return ranked results (title, url, context snippet). Use to ground architecture/cost reasoning in AWS guidance before answering or proposing a change.

search_phrase.description: Search phrase, e.g. 'Aurora Serverless v2 pricing' or 'RDS Multi-AZ failover'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 10).

name: read_documentation
description: Fetch an AWS documentation page (by URL from search_documentation) and return it as markdown text. Supports pagination for long pages via start_index.

url.description: URL of the AWS documentation page to read (must be a docs.aws.amazon.com URL).

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default 5000).

start_index.description: Character index to start reading from, to continue a previously truncated fetch (default 0).

name: recommend
description: Get related/recommended AWS documentation pages for a given documentation URL. Useful for discovering adjacent guidance after reading a page.

url.description: URL of the AWS documentation page to get recommendations for.
